name: Rome2Rio API
tagline: Multi-modal door-to-door routing across planes, trains, buses, and ferries worldwide.
description: Rome2Rio provides a multi-modal transportation API for door-to-door journey planning across planes, trains, buses, ferries, and other transport modes worldwide. Developers can search routes, get schedules, and compare travel options between any two locations.

auth.details: API key authentication required. Self-serve signup available.

use_cases: find multi-modal routes between two cities
compare train vs flight travel options
get door-to-door journey plans with transfers
search bus and ferry connections worldwide
